# Technical video fixtures (not public quiz content)

Source: Erčulj F, Štrumbelj E (2015), supplementary video to
“Basketball Shot Types and Shot Success in Different Levels of Competitive
Basketball”, PLOS ONE, CC BY 4.0.
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Basketball-Shot-Types-and-Shot-Success-in-Different-Levels-of-Competitive-Basketball-pone.0128885.s001.ogv
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Changes: resized to 640×360, muted, transcoded to H.264/30fps. The short fixture
is a 0.3-second tracking comparison segment. Used for decoder, masking, correction,
and native/browser compatibility tests; no verified NBA identity is asserted.
These files are not included in the website, public catalog or quiz pack.
